bayts.text: Praise be to God, and may He bless forever the one through whom guidance appeared to us,
our master Muḥammad and his Family, and his Companions, possessors of the gifts of the Sovereign.
That said, I today am one who makes intercession (tawassul) to Him by the names of the possessors of excellence,
and I said: O Near One (Qarīb), O Answerer (Mujīb), bless the one through whom You answer,
and accept through him this verse of mine, O Generous, and grant to whoever supplicates through it what he seeks.
Lord, by Noah (Nūḥ) and Abraham (Ibrāhīm), forgive my sins and suffice me against the Accursed.
And by Moses (Mūsā) and by the standing of Jesus (ʿĪsā), be my protector from misery in this world and the next.
And by Muḥammad, the Messenger of God, upon him be the best of God's blessings,
and then upon them, grant me a faith that has accompanied submission (Islām) and excellence (Iḥsān).
By the sanctity of Aṣ-Ṣiddīq and Al-Fārūq, bestow upon me sincerity and success.
By the right of ʿUthmān, brother of the Two Lights, and by ʿAlī, father of the two grandsons,
grant me in my worldly life and in my hereafter light, elevation and excellences.
By the right of Ṭalḥa and Az-Zubayr, and the right of Saʿd, deliver me from harm.
And by Saʿīd and Ibn ʿAwf, deliver me from all that I fear of trials (fitan).
And by Abū ʿUbayda, bring what benefits to my side and suffice me against what destroys.
By the right of ʿAbd Allāh, son of the paternal uncle, that is the son of Al-ʿAbbās, increase my knowledge.
By the right of ʿAbd Allāh, son of ʿUmar, suffice me constantly against whatever brings harm.
And by Ibn Masʿūd and the standing of Ibn Salām, guard me from affliction and the harm of the eye and of speech.
O our Lord, by the sanctity of Al-ʿAbbās and Ḥamza, suffice me against all hardship.
By the sanctity of Al-Ḥasan and Al-Ḥusayn, bestow upon me in the two abodes the two lights.
By the sanctity of Al-Qāsim, then Aṭ-Ṭāhir, purify my outward being together with my inner thoughts.
By the sanctity of Aṭ-Ṭayyib, Ibrāhīm, make lasting upon me gladness and honour.
By the standing of Fāṭima, wean my soul from all that drags me to confinement.
And by Ruqayya and Zaynab, suffice me at all times against rejection and veiling.
And secure me in this world and the next with generosity, by Umm Kulthūm, and keep me away from retributions.
By Aws ibn ʿĀmir, and Haram, and the right of Masrūq, accept my words.
And by Ar-Rabīʿ, and by the standing of Al-Aswad, grant me uprightness and straighten my crookedness.
By ʿĀmir ibn ʿAbd ar-Raḥmān, and by Abū Maslama Al-Khawlānī,
bestow upon me forgiveness and felicity, and knowledge, and action, and worship.
By Al-Ḥasan Al-Baṣrī, grant me scrupulous piety (waraʿ), and stripping away from my desire and from innovations.
And by Abū Hurayra, and by Bilāl, and by Ṣuhayb, Lord, bestow upon me Your gifts.
And accept my obedience, and heal me from sickness, inward and outward, by Abū ad-Dardāʾ.
By the sanctity of Al-Miqdād, then Khālid, and by Az-Zubayr, bring me to my aims.
And by the Commander of the Believers, ʿUmar (ibn al-Khaṭṭāb), guard me from guile, wretchedness and deception.
By the right of the leader of the fighters in the way of God, ʿAlī, who aided our religion,
by the right of Saʿd and by the right of ʿUrwa, increase my holding fast to the most firm handle.
By the sanctity of Al-Qāsim, then Khārija, increase me in following the ways of the Chosen One.
And by Abū Bakr and ʿAbd Allāh, increase me in a favour that has no end.
And by Sulaymān, guard me from the plot of the Accursed, and from the plot of others, and be my Helper.
By our Mother Khadīja, grant me hope in knowledge, and in good conduct, Lord, and in action.
By our Mother ʿĀʾisha, guard me from whatever harms me in the earths and the heaven.
By our Mother Ḥafṣa, always come between me and whatever brings evil and affliction.
By our Mother Zaynab, adorn what is outward of me and what is inward, and make me a refuge.
By Mālik and Ash-Shāfiʿī and Abū Ḥanīfa and Aḥmad, answer me.
By the standing of Gabriel (Jibrīl), answer my request, and make me reach the stature of the men of God.
By the standing of Michael (Mīkāʾīl), grant me blessings, and make my benefit like rain, generous.
By the standing of Isrāfīl, grant me protection, and suffice me against the terrors of the Day of Gloom.
By the standing of ʿAzrāʾīl, be for me, O Beautiful, all the length of my life and likewise after departure.
And make my intercession for whoever supplicates by it the felicity of the two abodes, and forgive me through it.
And bestow upon me, and upon the one who asked me for its composition, security and good pleasure,
and felicity and protection from the sum of evils, and care,
and deliverance from questioning and punishment, and the agonies of death, Lord, and the reckoning,
and glad tidings and joy at our death and at the Resurrection.
And send blessings and peace upon the Prophet, and his Family with the noble Companions.
And forgive my parents, and forgive all my family and the sum of my companions, O All-Hearing.
And forgive everyone connected with me, and bring to fulfilment my felicity, O my Lord.
And be gentle with us, and strengthen us, and be for us, and grant us a good ending, our Lord.
And send blessings and peace upon the Prophet, and through him fulfil the need of every Muslim.
